settings.intro:
Every piece in this library is a real writing sample created by an Australian kid and published in theINmag. Persuasive texts, informative texts and stories, all at genuine kid level, which makes them rare: mentor texts your students can actually measure themselves against.

Use them in planning, put one on the board as a shared read, or hand them over as independent reading. Kids inspiring kids is the whole idea. New samples land with every issue.
settings.cta_copy: theINmag publishes real kids in print, three times a year. Send IN their creation and it could be on these pages next.
